legende:
Four races with @antoine_bhna this year. Paris, Lyon, the World Championships in Stockholm, and Rome.

The clock doesn't lie, and it doesn't flatter either: our running and our lunges got a lot faster, and our sled push went the wrong way. Swipe for the details 📊

That's the honest version of a season. And it tells us exactly what to work on before Hong Kong.

Thank you Antoine for being on the other end of every rope and every sled ❤️

If you race doubles: what's the station you and your partner fight over? I read everything 🙏
